description: This file implements a C++ class and functions for constructing and encoding ASN.1 Paging messages for 5G NR (New Radio) based on paging grants, including memory management and message packing.

classes.name: paging_pdu_assembler::paging_message_buffer
classes.description: A helper class to generate ASN.1 Paging messages, caching memory for paging records.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_cell_paging_msg
methods.description: Builds an ASN.1 RRC-NR Paging message from paging grant information.

methods.name: paging_message_buffer::paging_message_buffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ASN.1 message structure and reserving space for paging records.

methods.name: paging_message_buffer::to_asn1
methods.description: Converts paging grant info into ASN.1 format, updating the message buffer.

methods.name: paging_pdu_assembler::encode_paging_pdu
methods.description: Encodes a paging grant into a byte buffer suitable for transmission.
